summary: The registrant, Granite Ridge Resources, Inc., filed a Form 8-K on August 19, 2026, reporting routine board expansion from seven to nine directors and the appointment of two independent directors, John Cocke and Jonathan Adams. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing contains only standard director appointment and committee assignment information under Item 5.02, with no deal terms, premiums, or transaction mechanics. It is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special-situation category.
